description: Resolve a place name, US state, or free-text query to National Park Service parks — the required first step before the detail tools. Returns each park's parkCode (the key nps_get_park, nps_get_alerts, nps_find_campgrounds, nps_get_activities, and nps_find_events all use) plus a compact trip-planning summary (designation, states, description, coordinates, headline activities, entrance fee, NPS page). Coverage is US NPS sites only — national parks, monuments, historic sites, seashores — not state parks and not Forest Service or BLM land.

activity.description: Filter to parks offering an activity, matched against each park's activities list (e.g. "hiking", "camping", "stargazing"). Case-insensitive substring match, combined with query/stateCode and applied before start/limit, so totalCount counts every matching park, not one page. Use nps_get_park to see a park's full activity list.

limit.description: Maximum parks to return (1–50). The full set is ~470 sites; narrow with query/stateCode rather than paging through everything.

query.description: Free-text search across park names and descriptions (e.g. "yosemite", "civil war", "redwood"). Exact parkCode or name matches lead, then other name matches, then parks that only mention the term in their description — ranked across every match before start/limit apply. Omit to browse by state. At least one of query or stateCode is recommended; with neither, returns the first page of all ~470 NPS sites.

start.description: Zero-based offset for pagination within the matched set. Use with limit to page through results.

stateCode.description: Two-letter US state/territory code, or comma-separated list (e.g. "CA", "WY,MT,ID"). Filters to parks located in those states. Combine with query to narrow.

name: nps_find_parks

appliedFilters.description: Echo of the filters as applied (query / stateCode / activity).

cap.description: The limit applied to this response (populated when results were truncated).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state_code`: A stateCode token is not two letters. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance on the result set: how to broaden a search that matched nothing, the start value for the next page when more parks matched, the way back when start ran past the end, and a best-effort disclosure when the activity scan could not cover every site.

parks.description: Matching parks, each carrying the parkCode needed to chain into the detail tools.

items.description: A matching park with its parkCode and trip-planning summary.

activities.description: Activity names available at the park (e.g. "Hiking", "Camping"). May be empty.

designation.description: Site type (e.g. "National Park", "National Monument", "National Historic Site"). Empty string for sites without a designation.

entranceFee.description: Lowest standard entrance fee as a dollar string (e.g. "35.00"), or null if the park is fee-free or lists no fee. Full fee/pass breakdown is in nps_get_park.

latitude.description: Center latitude (decimal degrees), or null if the park record has no coordinates.

longitude.description: Center longitude (decimal degrees), or null if absent.

parkCode.description: Park code — the key for nps_get_park, nps_get_alerts, nps_find_campgrounds, nps_get_activities, nps_find_events (e.g. "yose").

states.description: Comma-separated state codes the park spans (e.g. "CA", "WY,MT,ID").

url.description: Park's official NPS.gov page, with fuller detail than this summary.

shown.description: Number of parks returned in this response (populated when the result set was capped by limit).

totalCount.description: Total parks matching every filter, before start/limit were applied.

truncated.description: True when more parks matched than this response returned; absent on a complete result.

title: national-parks-mcp-server: find parks
